response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL AND length >= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_length DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Qualifying running time' with a 112-minute cutoff means length >= 112 (inclusive), i.e. at least 112 minutes.
Languages are grouped by film.language_id (not original_language_id). Languages with no qualifying films do not appear, so no averages are actually missing for returned rows.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: only films longer than 112 minutes qualify (length > 112).
